summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a remote-controlled PTY backdoor and harvests Anthropic credentials
details: The npm package ships a prebuilt macOS/amd64 Go binary that links a PTY library (github.com/creack/pty) and a WebSocket client (github.com/coder/websocket) together with a hardcoded relay endpoint wss://relay.sextant.top and a pion/webrtc stack, producing a network->PTY dataflow driven from an author-controlled relay (remote shell). The same binary contains a regex matching Anthropic API keys of the form sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}, references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and the Anthropic/Claude endpoints https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models and https://claude.ai/, indicating harvesting of the installer's Anthropic credentials and Claude configuration. The binary additionally performs host geolocation via http://ip-api.com/json/ and posts install-time host identifiers to https://relay.sextant.top/install. The package.json license field points to a repository named claude_control (https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control), matching the observed remote-shell and Claude-credential-harvesting behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
